name: Image-to-Physical Liver Registration Sparse Data Challenge
description: Benchmark and challenge for evaluating liver image-to-physical registration methods using a shared sparse-data dataset.
evaluation_method: Target Registration Error (TRE) / surface distance metrics (e.g., Hausdorff / mean surface distance) / Dice when applicable
general_score_metric: mean Target Registration Error (TRE) in millimeters (and complementary surface distance metrics)
reputation: A specialized clinical challenge with limited participation but relevance for the medical image registration community.
notes: Sparse clinical data and small dataset size can limit generalization; non-LLM benchmark requiring clinical/technical expertise; potential variability in acquisition protocols.
